content: The security policy database, which defines which connections shall be protected by IPsec and by which protections, may be configured via the settings in the container " TcpIpSpdEntry " and " TcpIpIpSecPriority ". The IpSecPriority is used to establish the order in which the SpdEntries are checked. The first successful rule match will be exec uted, disregarding all lower priority rules.
